dna.default: face=scale - a flat degree band and needle agree with the physical tuning wheel. The 2026-09-21 interface pass replaces the fictitious FM units and enlarges the case for full-size controls; authored placements require a fresh reach check.
dna.was: a hand-built front panel with no exports the sweep could turn: a Label3D reading '88 | 92 | 96 | 100 | 104 | 108' and a 1 cm needle box, both hard-coded in the scene, plus a display whose only vocabulary was a fake FM number. The tuning maths (station = round(angle / 40°), clarity = 1 - |offset|) was already an argument about continuum versus discrete stations, and the panel could only ever tell one side of it. apply_grid_config() did not exist.
dna.note: the axis does not touch the tuning maths — station index, proximity threshold and selected preset are identical across all four values. What changes is the panel's ACCOUNT of the spectrum: a continuum you can read a number off (scale), a row of discrete lamps where the between does not appear at all though you still hear it (presets), a stocked menu of nine proper nouns (list), or no map whatsoever, wheels and a dark display, find a station by ear (void). Same signal, four claims about what a station is.

capacity: TUNE between soundscape stations by turning a VR wheel — feeling the analog transition from signal to noise
description: Turn a full-size physical wheel through preset centres and their gaps; a second wheel controls live attenuation in dB. Four flat panel faces expose a degree band, station lamps, a named list, or no readings for tuning by ear. Station selection uses a distance threshold; gaps request the existing drone preset. Sound generation follows the latest queued selection.
gamwell_reference: Fourier analysis, signal processing, wave interference
interactions: turn VR hinge wheel to tune stations
name: SoundscapeRadioRack
qfep_connection: Lambda as tuning — the wheel angle IS lambda, sweeping through a spectrum of possible sounds. Between stations is noise (high E). At station center is signal (high F). The threshold parameter controls how sharp the transition is.
